content_fields.title: Verify that containers are restricted from acquiring additional privileges (Docker)
content_fields.description: Prevent privilege escalation inside the container.
content_fields.finding: no-new-privileges is not set in security_opt, and privileged mode would override it.
content_fields.required_fix:
# docker-compose.yml
  web:
    privileged: false
    security_opt:
      - no-new-privileges:true
    cap_drop: [ALL]
criteria: `no-new-privileges:true` is set and privileged mode is off.
A setuid binary inside the container cannot raise privileges.
